Custom Fit: Tailored to fit your vehicle’s floor contours perfectly, providing maximum coverage and protection.

Durable Material: Made from premium, high-density carpet that resists wear and tear, extending the life of your vehicle’s interior.

Easy to Clean: Designed for easy removal and cleaning, maintaining a fresh and tidy interior with minimal effort.

specItems.description:
"You operate the clutch, accelerator, and brake. It does the rest. 
- Sensors scan suitable parking spaces (up to max. 25 mph). 
- Parallel parking spaces must be at least the vehicle length plus 80 cm manoeuvring distance for parking and at least 25 cm in front and behind the vehicle for driving out of the space.
- Parking bays must have at least 35 cm clearance on both sides.
specItems.shortDescription: Park Assist can not only tell you whether a parking space is big enough as you drive by – it can also park for you.
